tableau_de_bord.execution_recouvrement: Overall consumption adds the lines of the approved version: an expense covered by two overlapping lines counts twice there (see availability per line)
tableau_de_bord.methode_consolidation: Latest “{type_taux}” rate on {jour}, in {reference}; each (project, currency) amount converted then rounded to the reference currency before addition
tableau_de_bord.taux_manquant: Indicator not consolidated: no “{type_taux}” rate on {jour} for {devises}
tableau_de_bord.execution_etat_courant: Budget execution (current budget, committed, spent) is as of today, not as of the requested date; the other indicators are as of the requested date
